firm_data.firm_description: Marulli, Mannarino & Erichsen, LLP is a Medical Malpractice / Personal Injury Defense firm in downtown Manhattan which has represented healthcare providers in professional malpractice claims. The firm has a separate area of focus on the representation of municipal mass transit entities and corporations.

email.subject: AI for Marulli, Mannarino & Erichsen, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gerry,

Since 1995, your firm has built a strong practice defending healthcare providers in complex malpractice claims across New York. That work demands precision and speed, especially when competing against larger defense teams.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
